subject: Data store technical + commercial handshake — Pinecone & Weaviate
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jon Park <jon@pinecone.io>, Sara Lim <sara@weaviate.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Data store technical + commercial handshake — Pinecone & Weaviate

Hi Jon & Sara,

Thanks again for the quick intro calls last week. We'd like to get a short handshake meeting this week to align on three things: technical pilot scope (index formats, fallthrough to S3/pgvector), commercial framing (pilot credits, evaluation SKUs), and operational handoffs (support SLAs, monitoring hooks).

Attaching a one-page agenda and a draft pricing matrix to kick off the commercial conversation. Proposed 30-minute slot options: Tue 6/4 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 6/5 14:00–14:30 PT — please tell us which works.

Quick context for Atlas Data (cc'd on the thread): they are evaluating a hybrid vector strategy — high-QPS index on Pinecone/Weaviate and cold persistence to S3 via pgvector. Key constraints: per-request latency <60ms p50 for lookup layer, strict data residency for embeddings (EU region), and 90-day retention for raw text.

Attachments: partner_handshake_agenda.pdf (pdf), pricing-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Vanessa
VP, Alliances
Redwood Inference
From: Jon Park <jon@pinecone.io>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data store technical + commercial handshake — Pinecone & Weaviate

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the note. Pinecone is definitely interested in the handshake. We're comfortable supporting a pilot that targets the latency goals you listed; a few quick asks from our side:

- Can Atlas share a sample QPS/traffic shape for the pilot (burst vs sustained)?
- We'll need to confirm data residency requirements (we have EU clusters; need mapping of regions).
- On commercial: Pinecone can provide 3 months of pilot credits + a discounted evaluation SKU if the pilot hits the throughput targets.

I've attached our Q2 product deck and a short SLA summary. Available for Tue 6/4 10:00 PT. If that works, please send calendar invite.

Attachments: pinecone-deck-q2.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Jon Park
Strategic Partnerships
Pinecone

Hi Vanessa — we can join and appreciate the clear scope. A couple of technical notes from Weaviate's side:

- Weaviate supports vector persistence to S3 via our snapshot/backup integration and we also have pgvector export tooling; want to confirm whether Atlas prefers a live fallthrough (read-through) to S3 or async cold-tiering.
- Weaviate will propose a 4-week pilot with a defined eval corpus and telemetry hooks; we typically instrument latency and recall on the same prompt set for regression gating.

For commercial, our partner team can extend a pilot credit package and a co-sell rebate if the customer commits to a 12-month consumed plan post-pilot.

Available Wed 6/5 14:00 PT — prefer that slot if Pinecone can also join.

Regards,
Sara Lim

Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Data store technical + commercial handshake — Pinecone & Weaviate

Vanessa — quick internal capture before the meeting:

1) Commercial asks to surface to partners now
   - Pilot credits duration: 90 days; target commitment triggers: throughput >= 2000 qps sustained for 1 minute, per-lookup p50 < 60ms
   - Evaluation SKU: want transparent per-token/per-index pricing for pilot vs production

2) Technical questions to close pre-call
   - Fallthrough model: prefer read-through for performance-critical queries; async cold-tier to S3 acceptable for archive and re-indexing flows
   - Index compatibility: require simple migration steps from partner index to pgvector-backed S3 (export/import scripts)
   - Observability: need token-level latency breakdown (Redwood can forward traces) and per-tenant metrics export to Atlas's Datadog.

3) Ops / support handoff
   - Escalation path: partner SE -> Redwood Partner CS -> Atlas engineering
   - SLA exceptions: require ability to route to Redwood Dedicated in burst scenarios (commercial implications noted)

I've updated the pricing-matrix-v1.xlsx with estimated pilot credit values and margin assumptions — attaching for review. I'll call out the commercial owner for each partner during the meeting.

Attachments: pricing-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

- Ben
Director, Partner GTM

- Commercial: partners to confirm pilot credits by EOD Mon 6/4; Redwood to provide an evaluation SKU and invoice terms for post-pilot conversion.
- Ops: partners to provide an SE for the pilot and a named escalation contact; Redwood will provision temporary tracing hooks and a shared Datadog dashboard.

- Atlas: traffic profile + confirmation of EU residency (ops@atlasdata.com)
- Pinecone: pilot credit amount and named commercial lead (jon@pinecone.io)
- Weaviate: pilot credit amount and proposed telemetry plan (sara@weaviate.io)
